sidebar.title: Library
sidebar.noRoots:
No library roots yet.
Folders you add appear here.

firstLaunch.title: Point Sift at your samples
firstLaunch.body: Sift indexes folders on your disks and drives. It only reads and catalogues files, never moves, copies, or writes to them.
firstLaunch.hint: Indexing runs in the background. Use the folder tree to browse. Files that are Online only stay in the list (they are not Missing). Analysis runs on local files and builds waveforms as it goes.

empty.title: No samples match
empty.body: Remove a filter chip, or widen the BPM range.

selection.drag_one: Drag to your DAW to copy the file
selection.drag_other: Drag to your DAW to copy all {{count}} files

missing.title: Sift can't reach this file
missing.body: The path is gone. The volume <0>{{volume}}</0> may be unmounted. Preview and drag-to-DAW are unavailable, but metadata and tags stay in the index until you remove the entry.

detail.noMoreTags: Every tag is already on this sample.

removeRoot.title: Remove this root from the library?
removeRoot.body_one: Sift forgets the <0>{{formatted}} sample</0> under it, with its tags, overrides, and favorites.
removeRoot.body_other: Sift forgets the <0>{{formatted}} samples</0> under it, with their tags, overrides, and favorites.
removeRoot.safe: Nothing on disk is touched. Re-add the folder later to index it again, but the tags do not come back.

removeMissing.body: Its index entry, tags and overrides are deleted. If the file comes back at the same path later it is indexed as a new sample.

askIndex.hint: You can keep browsing while this waits.

setBpm.noDuration: Sift needs the sample's length to work this out.

tagsDialog.title: Add or remove tags
tagsDialog.body_one: Ticked tags are on the selected sample.
tagsDialog.body_other: Ticked tags are on every one of the {{count}} selected samples.
